definitions.payment: an inbound USDT transfer >= 10 USDT from another wallet, before the freeze; one withdrawal by one customer (the sender)
definitions.questioned: payments the engine asked a question about (#7: first-time payee >= large_usdt, or weak evidence)
definitions.first_warning_real: the first payment at which the engine raised a Tether freeze signal (counterparty: question; destination: hold)
definitions.first_warning_modelled: the first confirming answer (it holds that payment) or simulated report
definitions.payments_after_warning: payments decided once a warning existed, including the payment whose answer confirmed it
definitions.payments_source_warned: payments whose decision cites the source's signal
definitions.payments_held: payments the engine put in the hold tier (call-back); each held attempt renews the report, an officer's cleared ends it
definitions.lead_days: freeze_ts - first warning ts, in days; median over wallets with a warning
definitions.payment_hold_rate: held payments / payments; on comparison wallets this is the legitimate-hold rate
definitions.false_confirm_rate: f: chance a legitimate customer's answer is classified as confirming a scam (modelled)
definitions.officer: each hold starts a call-back; a day later the officer records confirmed or cleared; right with probability q (modelled)
definitions.half_life: report half-life in payee memory (modelled setting; C's default 7 days, renewed by each held attempt)
